title: Advancing content provenance for a safer, more transparent AI ecosystem
summary: OpenAI advances AI content provenance with Content Credentials, SynthID, and a verification tool to help people identify and trust AI-generated media.
body: OpenAI advances AI content provenance with Content Credentials, SynthID, and a verification tool to help people identify and trust AI-generated media.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布推进AI内容溯源生态，通过全面支持Content Credentials、SynthID以及配套的验证工具，帮助公众准确识别并信任人工智能生成的各类媒体内容，提升整个AI生态的安全性与透明度。
